routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON tax rate; 4xx/5xx Cedros error envelope.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated Cedros admin context, cedros-pay:admin permission claim, and CSRF-verified admin write context.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Path id plus JSON body { name, country, region?, rateBps, active? }.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON tax rate; 4xx/5xx Cedros error envelope.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated Cedros admin context, cedros-pay:admin permission claim, and CSRF-verified admin write context.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Path id; no body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { deleted: true }; 4xx/5xx Cedros error envelope.

routeContracts.auth: Route-specific bearer or payload validation; Stripe calls use secrets and allowlisted egress.
routeContracts.requestSchema: GET query subscriptionId; no body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON subscription status with redacted provider references; 4xx/5xx Cedros error envelope.

routeContracts.auth: Requires admin context plus cedros-pay:balance-read or cedros-pay:subscription-read.
routeContracts.requestSchema: GET query window=P7D|P30D|P90D|PYTD|PALL; include=optional comma-separated string of revenue,subscriptions,timeseries,topRoutes,topProducts,comparison; optional minAttributionTxnCount. comparison is opt-in only.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON aggregate stats object containing only requested and permitted blocks. comparison contains previousGrossCents, previousTxnCount, previousWindowStart, and previousWindowEnd for the immediately preceding equal-length bounded window; PALL omits comparison. topProducts rows always contain productId and grossCents, with productName/productSlug when supported by the current catalog record. timeseries contains at most the most recent 400 one-day buckets and is never downsampled.

routeContracts.auth: Requires relying-party bearer secret; dormant until relying_party.shared_secret is configured.
routeContracts.requestSchema: GET query subjectId; no body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { subjectId, balanceCents, heldCents, availableCents, currency }; 4xx/5xx Cedros error envelope.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated admin/context claim for Cedros Pay product RAG records.
routeContracts.requestSchema: GET query limit=optional integer 0..100, offset=optional non-negative integer; no body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { source: 'products', records: ProductRagRecord[] } with public/operator-approved product facts only; 401/403/500 error envelope.

routeContracts.auth: Requires host-supplied cedros-pay:product-read capability claim for Shop or host storefront rendering.
routeContracts.requestSchema: GET query limit=optional integer 0..100 (default 50), offset=optional non-negative integer, slug=optional exact product slug, categoryId=optional exact category id, featured=optional true|false; no body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { contract: 'cedros-pay:product-read', products: StorefrontProduct[], categories: StorefrontCategory[], filters: { slug?, categoryId?, featured? }, pagination: { limit, offset, count, hasMore } }. StorefrontProduct includes id, title, optional slug/descriptions/SEO/tags/categoryIds/imageUrls/featured/price/compareAtPrice/inventoryStatus/fulfillment/variants/checkoutUrl. StorefrontCategory is derived from public product categoryIds as { id, slug, title, productCount }.

routeContracts.auth: Requires host-supplied cedros-pay:product-create capability claim (or a host-verified system-admin session) on an authenticated context.
routeContracts.requestSchema: POST JSON { title: required string 1..200, price: { amountCents: required integer 1..100000000, currency?: 3-letter ISO code (default USD) }, id?: string<=120 [A-Za-z0-9._-], slug?: string<=120 lowercase [a-z0-9-], description?: string<=5000, shortDescription?: string<=500, productType?: standard|service|ticket|eventSession|campSession|pass|addon, tags?: string[]<=20, categoryIds?: string[]<=20, imageUrls?: https URL[]<=10, featured?: boolean, active?: boolean (default true), public?: boolean (default true) }. Unknown fields are rejected.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { contract: 'cedros-pay:product-create', created: true, product: StorefrontProduct } where StorefrontProduct matches the cedros-pay:product-read projection (id, title, optional slug/descriptions/tags/categoryIds/imageUrls/featured, price, checkoutUrl).

routeContracts.auth: Requires host-supplied cedros-pay:entitlement-read capability claim from Data gated-media access checks.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON body { userId, checks: [{ scope: 'media_asset', scopeId, productId?, entitlementId? }] }; checks is 1..50 items.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { results: [{ scope, scopeId, productId?, entitlementId?, granted }] }; Data only treats results[0].granted === true as access.

routeContracts.auth: Requires host-supplied cedros-pay:subscription-read capability claim for trusted managed-provider integrations.
routeContracts.requestSchema: GET path subscriptionId=required non-empty string <=256 chars; no body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { subscriptionId, customerId, productId, status, entitlements: { managedProviderLimits }, updatedAt }. managedProviderLimits may include dailyRequestLimit, monthlyRequestLimit, monthlySpendCents, throttleRpm, routes[id].{monthlyRequestLimit,monthlySpendCents,throttleRpm}, and families[id].{monthlyRequestLimit,monthlySpendCents}.

routeContracts.auth: Requires relying-party bearer secret; returns redacted status by ledger reference only.
routeContracts.requestSchema: GET query ledgerRef or paymentRef; no body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON status with redacted ledger reference and terminal state; 4xx/5xx Cedros error envelope.

routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { kind, key, settings, updatedAt } where settings contains enabled, recipient, currencies, presets, label, description, and allowPerPostRecipient.

routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { kind, key, settings, updated, updatedAt } with the merged site_settings/tipping payload.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated Cedros admin context, admin-write CSRF proof, and cedros-pay:admin permission.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Path refundId; empty JSON body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 200 durable state for an already-submitted or succeeded refund; HTTP 503 refund_signer_unavailable for a pending refund.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated Cedros admin context, admin-write CSRF proof, and cedros-pay:admin permission.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Path refund id; optional empty JSON body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON containing the durable Stripe refund processing state.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated Cedros admin context, admin-write CSRF proof, and cedros-pay:admin permission.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Empty body or an empty JSON object only.

routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 acknowledgement after durable guarded projection or exact duplicate recognition.

routeContracts.requestSchema: Google Real-time Developer Notification Pub/Sub JSON.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 acknowledgement after durable guarded projection or exact duplicate recognition.

routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { productId, method, storeProductId, transactionId?, originalTransactionId?, purchaseToken?, metadata? }.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON verified purchase/entitlement outcome correlated to the provider transaction.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated buyer context owning the referenced purchase.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Authorization: Bearer <cedros-login session>; JSON { originalPurchaseId, recipientWallet, reason? }. The bearer credential is never copied into the body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON durable refund request state and stable refund id.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated buyer context.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON identifying the free subscription plan and selection identity.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON durable subscription selection and entitlements.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated buyer context and configured Stripe account scope.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON identifying the subscription plan, return URLs, and externally supplied idempotency identity.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON durable hosted Stripe session outcome.

routeContracts.auth: Requires a Cedros Login-verified buyer; the wallet must match the prepared subscriber and both proofs are looked up through user-authenticated activation.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict JSON { planId, interval, wallet, authorizationSignature, paymentSignature, subscriptionAddress, subscriptionAuthorityAddress?, planAddress?, numberOfPayments?, metadata? }. authorizationSignature proves Subscribe; paymentSignature proves the first TransferSubscription collection.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON durable active subscription with paymentMethod=solana_subscription, exact on-chain currentPeriodStart/currentPeriodEnd, paymentsCollected=1, initialPaymentSignature, and lastCollectionSignature.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated buyer context and configured Stripe account scope.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON subscription checkout request with plan and externally supplied idempotency identity.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON durable Stripe subscription session outcome.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the configured relying-party authorization and ownership of the subscription reference.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { subscriptionId } plus request idempotency context.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON durable cancellation state.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the configured relying-party authorization and validated customer/price references.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON subscription create material plus request idempotency context.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON durable subscription state.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the configured relying-party authorization and ownership of the subscription reference.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { subscriptionId, returnUrl }.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { url } for the provider-issued billing portal session.

routeContracts.auth: Require the site-generated stripe.webhook_token (query token or x-cedros-webhook-token header, exactly one), then obtain the authoritative Event with the site Stripe secret. A site without a token fails closed with 503; there is no Stripe-Signature path because Cedros hosts reserialize JSON.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Stripe Event notification JSON with evt_ id. Requires exactly one token query value or x-cedros-webhook-token header; all other submitted event fields are ignored.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 acknowledgement after one durable projection or exact duplicate recognition.

routeContracts.auth: Requires a Cedros Login-verified buyer; merchant, environment, provider, site, and buyer operation scope are host-derived.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict schemaVersion 1 quote intent with an unchanged 1..67-byte visible-ASCII Idempotency-Key and matching body key; accepts product intents or an exact versioned-cart binding, never caller prices or totals.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 canonical authoritative quote snapshot with operationId, attemptId, expiry, safe product facts, totals, requested methods, and optional hold identity; no provider URL, raw contact, token, or secret.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the same Cedros Login-verified buyer and host-derived operation scope that created the quote.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict schemaVersion 1 checkout intent binding one quote operation, attemptId, payment method, customer-context hashes, and unchanged 1..67-byte idempotency key.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 finite durable outcome: action_required, processing, paid, terminal, or indeterminate, always correlated to operationId and attemptId.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the verified identity and host-derived provider scope that owns the checkout operation.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Path operationId; no body and no caller-selected provider scope.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 finite durable checkout outcome correlated to operationId and attemptId; never a provider URL.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the verified identity and host-derived provider scope that owns the checkout operation.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict schemaVersion 1 body with operationId, expected attemptId, and provider-issued return artifact.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 ephemeral verified action URL/outcome; URL is never persisted and production permits only the configured provider HTTPS origin.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the verified identity and host-derived provider scope that owns the original checkout attempt.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict schemaVersion 1 body with expectedAttemptId and provider-issued returnArtifact; operationId is rejected.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 verified outcome with checkoutAttemptId, or mismatch/indeterminate with status only; no operation id or provider detail is disclosed.

routeContracts.auth: Requires a Cedros Login-verified buyer; subject and Shop provider scope are host-derived.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict schemaVersion 1 request for the fixed default lane; caller cannot select subject, provider scope, generation epoch, price, or inventory.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 authoritative generation revision and current cart state.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the verified buyer whose host-derived subject/provider scope owns the cart.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict schemaVersion 1 fixed-lane read request.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 authoritative generation and cart state including public version and opaque host revision.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the verified buyer whose host-derived subject/provider scope owns the cart.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict schemaVersion 1 fixed-lane request carrying the current opaque generation revision.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 new authoritative generation revision/epoch and cart state, or stale_generation with authoritative recovery state.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the verified buyer whose host-derived subject/provider scope owns the cart.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict schemaVersion 1 fixed-lane mutation with opaque generation revision, expected public cart version, unchanged operationId, and intent-only add/update/remove/replace/clear material.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 applied, replayed, conflict, stale_generation, or idempotency_conflict outcome with authoritative recovery state where required.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the end user's Cedros Login bearer credential; buyer identity is verified through the existing Login relying-party contract.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict JSON { planId, interval, wallet, authorizationSignature, subscriptionAddress, subscriptionAuthorityAddress?, planAddress?, numberOfPayments? }. No signer material, RPC URL, amount, mint, recipient, or collector is caller-controlled.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 503 { error: { code: collector_signer_unavailable } } after validating the buyer-owned authorization proof and collection intent; no transaction is originated until a host-managed signing contract is published.

routeContracts.auth: Requires a regular authenticated Cedros Pay administrator (with host-verified CSRF for writes) or an exact host-attested bearer capability claim for this route.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { invite: { stableHandle, programHandle, subjectId, activationCodeSha256?, status, expiresAt?, metadata? } }; only a lowercase SHA-256 digest is accepted, never a raw activation code.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { kind: programInvite, created, recordId, record }; read-back redacts the digest and reports activationCodeConfigured only.

routeContracts.auth: Requires a regular authenticated Cedros Pay administrator (with host-verified CSRF for writes) or an exact host-attested bearer capability claim for this route.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { membership: { subjectId, programHandle, status, expiresAt?, transitionPlanHandle?, metadata? } }.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { kind: programMembership, created, recordId, record } with the stable subject-scoped membership id.

routeContracts.auth: Requires a verified Cedros Login buyer session; the host-derived subject must match the invite subject.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Strict JSON { activationCode }; referralCode and all unknown fields are rejected.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { activated, programHandle, membershipId, status, expiresAt } without returning the activation code or subject.

routeContracts.auth: Requires a verified Cedros Login buyer session.
routeContracts.requestSchema: No body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { active, membership } with program, status, expiry, and transition plan only.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the buyer's Cedros Login session; Pay verifies the session and subscription ownership before cancellation.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { subscriptionId } plus the buyer Authorization bearer and request idempotency context.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON durable cancellation state.

routeContracts.auth: Requires the buyer's Cedros Login session; Pay verifies the session and subscription ownership before issuing a billing portal URL.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { subscriptionId, returnUrl } plus the buyer Authorization bearer.
routeContracts.responseSchema: 200 JSON { url } for the provider-issued billing portal session.

routeContracts.auth: Bearer-authenticated Cedros platform context derived from a verified signed Assistant request; requires the exact route capability, ai-assistant identity, action, stable run/request/idempotency values, explicit approval, and positive authorized ceiling.
Host-attested Cash Captcha extension-service context only.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { schemaVersion:1, offerRef, sourceId, durationSeconds }.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 200 { schemaVersion:1, offer402:{ immutable scope, duration, price, rail, network, safe payment instructions } }; Cedros error envelope otherwise.

routeContracts.auth: Public buyer x402 payment proof plus a delegated Ed25519 public key.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { schemaVersion:1, offerRef, delegatedPublicKey, challengeId? }; X-PAYMENT carries the base64 JSON x402 envelope on settlement.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 402 machine challenge; 202 pending; or 200 issued credential and immutable validity.

routeContracts.auth: Host-attested Cash Captcha extension-service context plus a fresh delegated Ed25519 request proof.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON schema-v1 credential, delegatedPublicKey, method/source/path/query binding, and Ed25519 timestamp/nonce/signature proof.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 200 exact active pass projection with opaque passId/subjectRef; stable Cedros denial envelope otherwise.

routeContracts.auth: Authenticated Pay administrator with verified CSRF.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Exact schema-v1 immutable access-pass offer terms and initial lifecycle.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 201 created or 200 exact idempotent replay.

routeContracts.auth: Authenticated Pay administrator with verified CSRF.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { schemaVersion:1, offerRef, state: active|inactive|retired, retirementAtMs? }.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 200 updated offer lifecycle.

routeContracts.auth: Authenticated Pay administrator with verified CSRF.
routeContracts.requestSchema: JSON { schemaVersion:1, passId }.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 200 { schemaVersion:1, passId, status:revoked }.

routeContracts.responseSchema: contractVersion 1 normalized OrderSummary items with nextAfter, or OrderDetail item, exact integer-string amounts and nullable historical breakdowns including tipAtomic. Core supplies stable expiring authorized Portal snapshots.
